items.title: A unique-point stack contains a unique strictly full reduced locally Noetherian one-point substack
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter properties.tex (Properties of Algebraic Stacks)

items.difficulty_reason: Pick a field presentation Spec(k) -> Z (surjective flat lft), form R = U x_Z U with flat lfp legs (field source), get Z' = [U/R] algebraic by the flat-groupoid criterion; the canonical map Z' -> Z is fully faithful (map-space-into-stack) hence representable and a monomorphism; the presentation U -> Z' is surjective flat lfp so Z' satisfies unique-point-better; replace by the essential image; uniqueness for a second Z'' via the projections from the fibre product being monomorphisms with nonempty middle (points-cartesian), hence isomorphisms by monomorphism-into-point.
